_note: Restricted / prohibited PRODUCT TYPES (not words -- the claims screener handles words). Per-marketplace status because status differs by marketplace (FPV goggles: UK prohibited / US restricted). Every entry carries a per-marketplace 'source': 'amazon_notice' = confirmed from Amazon's own violation notice (verbatim reason); 'amazon_notice_pending' = a real Amazon notice exists but exact text not yet captured; 'unverified' = educated guess, CONFIRM before relying. Matching a product to a TYPE is fuzzier than matching a word: obvious cases hit reliably, disguised ones may slip -- a strong WARNING, never a guarantee. NO MATCH != SAFE.
no_match_message: No known restriction matched -- this is NOT a clearance. Unlisted or disguised product types can still be restricted or prohibited by Amazon or a regulator. Verify before sourcing/listing.

reason.US: This product has been identified as a nebulizer, classified as a medical device by the FDA. If not for professional use, the following documentation is required: (1) a 510(k) number issued by the U.S. FDA for this product; (2) the device manufacturer's FDA establishment registration number or owner/operator number; (3) a purchase order, invoice, or letter (in English) from the manufacturer confirming the device was purchased from the manufacturer. Amazon may also require photos of all sides of the packaging and photos of the instructions for use.
